name: send_message
description: Send text to one or more contacts using their references. Each call submits one message and returns a submission reference; acceptance does not confirm delivery.

recipients.description: Contact references available in the working context.

name: fork_session
description: Transfer the whole current activation's work to one child that inherits the complete retained working context, and return its session_id. The caller's activation ends. The child's final text returns as one combined report to its direct parent. At most one fork per round.

task.description: Task and continuation instructions for the activation's whole work.
